blurb: Jester King Brewery is a world-renowned brewery located on a ranch near Austin, Texas. Guests can enjoy wood-fired pizza, beer, and interact with a herd of Nigerian Dwarf goats. The property includes a brewery, goat pen, nature trail, and event spaces for private and corporate events.
